{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Velvet midi skirt, A-line cut reaching the floor, color #3e2725 (deep brown), heavy velvet fabric.
Structured blazer with notched lapels, tailored fit through the waist and hips, color #8d6e63 (warm taupe), wool-blend fabric.
Silk blouse with a pussy-bow neck, relaxed yet neat silhouette, color #f5f5dc (cream), crisp silk fabric.
Block-heel sandals, geometric 5 cm heel, closed toe with a strap across the instep, color #8d6e63 (warm taupe), leather material.

This outfit works perfectly for an evening at the theatre as it adheres strictly to your wishes for a maxi skirt and heeled footwear within your requested 4 to 6 cm range. The rich textures of velvet and silk, paired with the structured blazer, elevate the look from neat casual to a refined smart ensemble suitable for a cultural event. The warm earth tones complement your natural coloring while ensuring the silhouette remains elegant and appropriate for the evening setting under artificial lighting."}
